q1_issues.issue: The sealed "he thought" clause carries no (Past sk_think_1), although a sealed proposition is to be parsed as usual including its tense.
"perhaps" is dropped entirely, so the U.S. District Court venue is recorded inside the seal exactly as flatly as the unhedged state-court one.
The two coordinated venue PPs become two Location atoms on one appeal event, which says a single appealing took place in both courts rather than that a second appeal might follow.

q2_gaps: a hedging adverb ("perhaps") scoping over a single coordinated adjunct rather than a whole clause — the epistemic operators Might/Probably attach only to an event, and nothing carries modal force inside a seal
coordinated PP adjuncts on one event (distributive replication is defined only for coordinated argument NPs and clauses)
notes: The ask event gives "him" no role of its own, which matches the control/causative pattern where the object lives only in the embedded event, so it is not counted as a defect. The split between state_court as a bare-kind constant with its genus and us_district_court as a named individual whose kind word sits inside the name is handled correctly.
